description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Considered a mace.

1 Action (1 scrap): Reach 1, Damage 1d6+STR Bludgeoning. If you target your turret, you undeploy it and regain its Toolbelt scrap.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Target is Dazed, 3 turns, or the turret lasts +3 rounds.

Passive: Turrets can be Tiny.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Rolls 1d6+STR Bludgeoning.

[A] Target your own turret: the module asks to recall it, removes the token and refunds its 1 Toolbelt scrap (chat card with Undo) — net 0 scrap, as the rules intend. If Nimble did not charge the scrap for this use (item unequipped or resource spending turned off), nothing is refunded and the card says so.

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Tool Wrench (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Tool Wrench" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] "Considered a mace" (for Scrapper's Applied Force): Nimble has no weapon-group field here, so it is left untyped to keep crits working for every Engineer.
